featured_reviews.name: Corina Gmail Handle
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came to this salon after a previous hairdresser had completely compromised my blonde. The color was left overly light, brassy, and dominated by yellow and orange tones—far from the refined blonde I had hoped for. I arrived simply wishing it could be softened or improved.

What Houshila, Rohit, and Bhushan delivered went far beyond that. Their expertise in color correction is truly exceptional. They transformed my hair into a beautifully balanced, luminous blonde with a polished, expensive finish—elegant, sophisticated, and impeccably executed.

A week later, I returned for a follow-up, and Rohit carefully assessed the color with great attention to detail. We decided to enhance it further with a purple shampoo treatment and a precision haircut. The result was flawless—my hair looks and feels absolutely stunning.

Beyond their technical excellence, the experience itself was elevated by genuine warmth, kindness, and professionalism. This is a salon that delivers luxury not only in results, but in service. I cannot recommend it highly enough, especially Houshila, Rohit, and Bhushan, whose talent and care are truly outstanding

featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this salon with my mother about a week ago for a haircut, eyebrow service, and gel nail paint. Unfortunately, the gel paint began peeling on the second day, which was very disappointing.

I contacted the salon and shared photos of the issue. Instead of addressing the problem professionally, the staff member blamed my mother, saying she was moving her hands too much. I then asked when my mother could come in for a redo.

When my mother visited for the redo, the experience was even worse. She was made to wait for nearly two hours, while other customers who arrived later were attended to first. The behavior toward my mother was rude and disrespectful, and the final result still lacked proper finishing and quality.

Overall, this was a waste of money and a very discouraging experience. It appeared that customers were treated differently based on their appearance. My mother is a simple person, and she was not given the respect every customer deserves.

I would not recommend this salon to anyone expecting professionalism, fairness, and quality service.

Special mention to Pratibha for her excellent expertise in hair colour and highlights—you can completely trust her with your hair.
Also, for pedicure services, Ram is highly recommended. He is very dedicated, skilled, and humble, and always does a fantastic job

featured_reviews.review_text:
Pratibha at blow has been my stylist for more than 10 years. She is perfect and guides and provides the client the right advice. Pratibha is updated with the latest fashion be it hair cuts, styling,  hair color,  hair treatment ..
I follow her and vouch for her... love you babe ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Prerna Kharade
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a wonderful experience at Blow Hair & Beauty Salon.
Special thanks to Darshana for the waxing and gel polish services. She is extremely professional, gentle, and very attentive to hygiene. She made sure I was comfortable throughout the waxing, and the gel polish finish was neat, perfect, and long-lasting.
The staff is courteous, the ambience is clean and relaxing, and the service quality is truly commendable. I am very happy with the overall experience and would definitely recommend this salon to anyone looking for quality beauty services.
Thank you, Darshana, for such lovely service 🌸

featured_reviews.name: Parab Sanjivani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good service. I had done Korean Face and Hair Spa which was excellent.
Manicure, Pedicure, waxing, Haircut.
Thanks to Jessi for excellent massage and Jif for my haircut. Polite staff.
Overall experience was very good.

featured_reviews.name: Priya Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came down with an appointment & still the treatment I got was so so good. Not just just my nails I got my hair cut done from Pratibha & I loved it. Even my nails were done so good.
My go to salon always!

featured_reviews.name: Priyasha Murarka
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went for my nails for a filler and gel polish.
In less than 5 days my entire nail broke. It was my real nail. They tried to fix it but it became worse. They wanted me to come to fix it and then charged me for the service. I have to go for an important event now with broken nails and get medical help for the nail broken. Not just a bad service but horrible experience and they had the guts to ask me if I wanted to get a clean up. They don’t have any knowledge of client servicing.

featured_reviews.name: simran oswal
featured_reviews.review_text: Raj did an absolutely amazing job with my hair colour! He put in so much effort and made sure the final look was elegant and beautifully done. I am extremely pleased with the result. Truly well-deserved appreciation — highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Aryan Navalkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Not sure about others, but here’s a little trick they pull. Haircut’s supposed to be ₹200, but they ask for ₹250. Only *IF* you question it, they go “Oh, you didn’t wash your hair (a service they provide), so yeah it’s ₹200.” Happened to me once (I paid ₹250 not knowing), then my brother got charged ₹200 only because he asked. Next time, they tried it again.

The quality is mediocre (they messed up the shape of mustache and made it uneven), and these practices on top make it disappointing.

To the owner—either your staff’s confused or you’re running a shady game. Either way, not how business is done, you should know better.
